sn56.1:1.6: Idam dukkhan ti pajānāti || ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtam pa- || ayam dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtam pa- || ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 4.
sn56.1:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yogo karanīyo || Ayam dukkhanirodho ti yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo || || 2.
